summary: Three jiao theory for warm disease diagnosis

sections.title: Three Jiao Differentiation Chapter One
sections.originalText: 上焦如雾，中焦如沤，下焦如渎。
sections.translation: The upper jiao is like mist, the middle jiao is like foam, the lower jiao is like a ditch.
sections.interpretation: This chapter uses vivid metaphors to describe the characteristics and functions of the three jiao in warm disease pathology.

keyConcepts.description: The theoretical framework dividing the body into upper, middle, and lower jiao for warm disease diagnosis
